info.description:
The ORCID Member API lets ORCID member organizations read and update researchers' ORCID records with their permission.

Calls about a record need an access token that the record owner granted to your member client through 3-legged OAuth: `https://sandbox.orcid.org/oauth/authorize` to ask for permission, then `https://sandbox.orcid.org/oauth/token` to exchange the code (in production, the same paths on `orcid.org`). Search, group IDs, webhooks and permission notifications take a 2-legged token from the client credentials grant instead.

Send `Accept: application/json` on every request. Without it the API answers in XML. These pages show JSON only; every operation also reads and writes XML (`application/vnd.orcid+xml`).

Every operation on these pages, and each class of error, was exercised against a running Registry by the ORCID API contract tests, and the examples are the requests and responses those tests recorded.

orcid_auth.description: Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens that act on a record come from the authorization code flow, after its owner grants access; other tokens come from client credentials. Only member clients can use this API. Sandbox URLs are shown; in production use `https://orcid.org/oauth/authorize` and `https://orcid.org/oauth/token`.

scopes./read-limited: Read the items the record owner shares with trusted parties, and the public ones.
scopes.openid: Sign the user in with OpenID Connect; the token response carries an ID token.
